newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were weaker in after-hours trade on Friday, as the yen's rebound against the dollar late in the day helped prices shed early gains, traders said.
Prices were flat to 0.3 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark June was off 0.1 yen at 145.8.
Activity was slow as private investors retreated to sidelines for most of the day amid a lack of fresh incentives.
"Uncertainty over the currency market thinned market volume," a trader said. Better weather in rubber-producing countries was also cited as a bearish factor.
